game.name: Google Minesweeper
game.rules:
For more categories, visit https://www.speedrun.com/gdce/#Minesweeper

If you have any questions, feel free to ask them in a forum post, on Discord, or message a moderator.

In-game timer must be used when submitting runs in Any% category.

If you don't have a screen recording software, just record the screen with your phone or a camera. Make sure the timer is clearly visable for verification purposes.

RTA timers should only be used in 100% categories.

RTA timers are not required for 100% runs either, as we'll retime your runs anyway.

Screenshots are NOT considered a valid proof - it is incredibly easy to fake screenshots in this game, especially in web version.

Runs require video proof. No exceptions. 

Do NOT submit privated videos! If you don't want your video to be seen by anyone outside of users on speedrun.com, set your video to Unlisted instead.

Please do not cut off the timer when recording your videos. It may be seen as an attempt to cheat/hide the real time of your run.

100% runs require you to complete Easy, Medium and Hard modes all in one run, not segments of multiple attempts. Howerever, you can play the 3 difficulties in any order.

Mild video edits are allowed that do not affect the run itself.

Slowing/Speeding up the footage or making cuts in the video is not allowed.

0 second runs are retimed manually by moderators.

0 second runs that required no additional cells to be removed are timed with 0.167s 

Web category is for the web version of the game (Horizontal layout) played with Mouse/Keyboard or with touchscreen, as it doesn't give any advantage over Mouse/Keyboard.

Mobile category is for devices that google recognises as phones (the ones with vertical layout).
You can play on the google website or with the built-in app in Google Play Games app.

Manipulating a screen in Web Mobile is NOT allowed, screen rotation is fine though.

newsList.title: Leaderboard Revamping
newsList.body:
Web runs done on devices that google recognises as phones (the ones with vertical layout) have been moved over to the mobile category, as there is no discernable difference between the two.

So basically:

**Vertical Layout is MOBILE** (either website or the app) and must be played with touchscr
